children: Global AI revenue reached an annualized run rate of $229B by the end of August, up 3.5x from a year earlier, according to Exponential View data shared by Daily Chartbook.

The significant increase comes amid a massive corporate push into artificial intelligence, as companies ramp up spending on AI infrastructure and technology. However, the surge has also led to fears of an AI bubble, raising questions over whether the industry's explosive revenue growth can keep pace with the expectations built around it.
Trailing 12-month AI revenue reached $140B in August, 3.2x the $44B recorded in August 2025, the chart showed. The trailing 12-month figure was doubling every 7.2 months.
A chart posted on X showed global AI revenue accelerating sharply from 2025 into 2026, with the annualized run rate rising from around $65B in August 2025 to $229B by August 2026.
The chart covers global AI revenue from January 2023 through August 2026, with June through August 2026 marked as projections.

title: AI revenue surges 3.5-fold in a year to $229B run rate
